messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

The passages do not provide a Semiconductor-specific ranking of “most important” signaling test capabilities; they support the following wireless device signaling-test capabilities as the relevant set.[25]
| Capability area | Supported capabilities | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Multi-technology signaling / network emulation | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD.[25] | [25] |
| 5G / LTE / WLAN signaling and measurements | CMX500 provides NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, and WLAN signaling plus WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO.[25] | [25] |
| Core RF measurements | Signaling test scope includes basic RF measurements: Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER and MIMO.[39] | [39] |
| Application-layer testing | Signaling test scope includes application layer tests such as IP throughput, Video and Audio.[39] | [39] |
| Protocol testing | Signaling test scope includes protocol test.[39] | [39] |
| IP application and traffic tools | R&S CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT test applications including DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server.[5] | [5] |
| Advanced IP / QoS / delay / traffic analysis | R&S CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings; R&S CMX-KA150 provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic.[5] | [5] |
| IMS voice and audio quality | R&S CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice calls, R&S CMX-KA181 adds POLQA for perceived speech quality measurement, and R&S CMX-KA401 supports WAV player / recorder, WAV upload / download, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay.[5] | [5] |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling | For Wi-Fi 7 R&D, R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality, intended to test wireless device operation under cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards in a single instrument setup.[35] | [35] |
| Wi-Fi 7 real-world RF TX / RX and MLO-related testing | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world conditions for RF TX / RX characteristics, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important.[35] | [35] |
| Wi-Fi 7-specific tests | The listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.[35] | [35] |
| Cellular/WLAN interworking | CMX500 is used for cellular 5G and WLAN seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration, including WLAN offloading and Voice over WLAN handover during a voice call.[37] | [37] |
| De-sense / coexistence validation | If a UAV uses two or more communication technologies, the source says communication technologies can interfere with one another, and CMX500 support for multiple communication technologies enables De-sense validation.[3] | [3] |
| Mobility and service scenarios | CMX500 callbox application / mobility use cases include Mobility Testing, Network Slicing, IP Throughput, Security Analysis, Backend Service, IMS Services, WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN, ATSSS, Power Consumption, XR Responsiveness & L4S, eCall / NGeCall and Speech Quality.[29] | [29] |
| Automation and scripting | CMX500 interfaces include CMsquares for RF, functional, advanced signaling and protocol tests; CMXmars for message log analysis; CMsequencer for graphical scripting; XLAPI for Python-based scripting; and SCPI for remote control.[4] | [4] |
| Regulatory signaling contexts | For 5G NR SAR testing, a 5G NR network emulator is required to drive the EUT to extreme transmission condition, and multi-radio UE average-SAR needs flexible signaling functions covering cellular standards, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.[74] | [74] |
| EMC signaling contexts | For Art 3.1b EMC, tests need radio enabled and radio disabled conditions, so 5G NR needs a signaling solution; mobile phones require Audio Breakthrough testing from GSM to VoLTE / VoNR by 5G.[74] | [74] |
| Semiconductor / SerDes caveat | The Semiconductor-related SerDes/SI/PI passages list interface test, transmission channel validation, RefClk and PLL jitter, PDN, ADC / DAC frontend performance and signal integrity flow, but they do not describe these as wireless signaling test capabilities.[41] | [41] |

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。
